title: Reverse Bits
description:
Reverse the bits of an unsigned 32-bit integer `n` and return the result as an unsigned integer.

For example, `00000010100101000001111010011100` becomes `00111001011110000010100101000000`.
hints: Build the answer one bit at a time: shift the result left, then append the lowest bit of n.
Use `>>> 0` so the result is read as unsigned.
